body.title: load-bearing (partially superseded: production scope)

messages.text: We keep improvising deploys per environment. Can we standardize how gullwing-deploy ships builds?
The in-house process fits both targets: scripts/pull_deploy.sh runs on the target host, pulls the tagged build, swaps the symlink, and reloads. Same flow works for staging and production.
Good enough to standardize on. DECISION: gullwing-deploy ships every environment — staging and production alike — with the pull-deploy process (scripts/pull_deploy.sh).
Recorded as the standard for all environments.
